matches.rationale: No finding addresses the equation (3) decomposition mixing concatenation/subscript notation for unimodal and cross-modal updates; the single finding concerns a different equation (attention scaling).

The finding identifies the same substantive defect—cross-attention logits scaled by sqrt(N_t) (token length) rather than by the feature dimension d—and even notes the resulting contradiction with the d-based formula elsewhere in the paper, matching the core mechanism of gt_id 2 despite citing a different section label (Appendix vs. Section 2.2.2), which is permissible under R1/R3.
No finding discusses equation (13)'s inconsistent application of matrix B to the zero vector for text token cross-modal updates.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly flags the sqrt(N_t) vs. sqrt(d) scaling inconsistency, matching gt_id 2's core mechanism even though it locates it in the Appendix rather than Section 2.2.2.
